strings.Pour un PC modeste ou un portable : effe: For a modest PC or a laptop: light effects off, edges smoothed.
strings.Se choisit tout seul dès qu'un effet cha: Picked automatically as soon as an effect changes.
strings.Tous les effets et l'image la plus fine: All effects and the finest image (1.5× supersampling), for a recent graphics card.
strings.Exigence pour la carte graphique (GPU),: Demand on the graphics card (GPU), processor (CPU) or memory (RAM):
strings.La taille de l'image au démarrage du jeu: The image size when the game starts; it shipped at 640×480. Pick your screen's own for the sharpest image; it can also be changed in the game's options.
strings.Plein écran sans bordure : le jeu couvre: Borderless full screen: the game covers the whole screen, and Alt+Tab switches to another window without freezing it (recommended). Window: an ordinary window, resizable or not. Borderless, image size: no frame and no stretching.
strings.Le format de l'image. « D'origine » gard: The image's aspect ratio. "Original" keeps the one the game expects; pick your screen's (16:10, 21:9, 32:9) so the image fills it without being stretched.
strings.Avec plusieurs écrans, ouvre toujours le: With several monitors, always opens the game on Windows' main monitor. Off, it opens on the monitor it starts on.
strings.En mode fenêtre, garde le jeu devant tou: In window mode, keeps the game in front of every other window, even when you click elsewhere.
strings.Le jeu ne se fige plus quand une autre f: The game no longer freezes when another window comes to the front, and takes the keyboard back as soon as you return.
strings.Cale les images sur la fréquence de l'éc: Matches frames to the screen's refresh rate: no more horizontal tearing when the camera turns. In return, a little more delay between the mouse and the image. With a frame limit that does not divide the screen's refresh rate, the game can drop to half of it (144 on a 180 Hz screen gives 90 frames): pick another limit then.
strings.Se déplacer avec {0}, Charme au clic gau: Move with {0}, Charm on left click, Jinx on right click, Accio on {1}, Extremos on {2}. The original keys keep working, except {3}, which moves back.
strings.Une manette PlayStation 4 ou 5 branchée: A connected PlayStation 4 or 5 controller is seen as an Xbox controller, which the game knows. Turn it off if Steam Input or DS4Windows already convert it: the game would see it twice.
strings.Les vibrations d'une manette PlayStation: Vibration of a PlayStation controller connected by USB. No effect over Bluetooth.
strings.Adoucit les escaliers au bord des person: Smooths the jagged edges of characters and scenery (hair, clothes, tent cloth), with a little sharpening. It also carries the effects below: turning it off turns off contact shadows, bloom, light shafts and colours.
strings.Rend du piqué à l'image que le lissage (: Gives back the crispness that smoothing (FXAA) softens: sharper edges and textures. Too strong, a light halo appears around edges.
strings.Lisse les contours des personnages et du: Smooths the edges of characters and scenery by computing several points per pixel. The higher the number, the smoother, and the harder the graphics card works. Turning it on turns off contact shadows, which keep it from reaching the scenery.
strings.Avec l'anticrénelage, lisse aussi les po: With anti-aliasing on, also smooths the tips of hair, leaves and grass. NVIDIA cards only; the graphics card works harder where there are many leaves.
strings.Calcule l'image en plus grand puis la ré: Renders the picture larger, then scales it down: edges, hair, foliage and distant detail much finer. The setting you see the most, and the most demanding: ×2 is for powerful PCs.
strings.Sols, murs et chemins vus en biais reste: Floors, walls and paths seen at an angle stay sharp instead of blurring (anisotropic filtering). Almost free on a recent graphics card.
strings.Garde les textures nettes plus loin : so: Keeps textures sharp further away: floors, walls and paths stay detailed instead of blurring with distance. A strong setting can make some surfaces shimmer.
strings.Feuilles, cheveux et grilles gardent leu: Leaves, hair and fences keep their density in the distance instead of thinning out and vanishing. Most visible in forests.
strings.Assombrit les recoins, le pied des murs: Darkens corners, the foot of walls and where objects touch: the scenery gains depth (ambient occlusion). Turning them on turns off anti-aliasing (MSAA).
strings.Calcule les ombres portées en plus fin :: Renders cast shadows finer: sharp edges instead of blurry, jagged ones. Experimental: also enlarges reflections, and uses more video memory. At your own risk: in Half-Blood Prince, ×4 leaves dark patches on characters outdoors when the camera turns.
strings.Les lumières vives (fenêtres, torches, s: Bright lights (windows, torches, spells) spill softly around them.
strings.Des rayons partent des sources de lumièr: Rays stream from strong light sources, like the sun through the trees.
strings.Active la vivacité et le contraste ci-de: Turns on the vibrance and contrast below, sparing faces. Off: the game's original colours.
strings.Ravive les couleurs ternes sans saturer: Brings dull colours to life without oversaturating the others. Only with "Reworked colours".
strings.Creuse l'écart entre zones claires et so: Widens the gap between light and dark areas. Only with "Reworked colours".
strings.Le voile vert dans lequel le jeu noie le: The green haze the game drowns distant scenery in. Off: sharp, contrasted hills and landscapes, the scene a little darker.
strings.Affiche les images par seconde en haut à: Shows frames per second in the top-left corner. In game, F10 hides or shows it.
strings.Temps par image et son graphe, processeu: Frame time and its graph, processor, graphics card, video and system memory, latency. In game, F11 starts a benchmark and F11 again stops it; it is saved in the game's “benchmarks” folder.

strings.La taille à laquelle l'image est calculé: The size at which the image is computed, whatever size the game picks. “The screen's” gives the sharpest image; “Up to 1080p” eases a modest graphics card on a large screen.
Smooths the jagged edges of objects. 8x is the shipped value; 4x looks barely different and costs less. If the game stops as soon as it starts (“SetRenderTarget failed”), try 4x, then “None”: some graphics chips, Intel ones in particular, refuse 8x.
strings.Applique la résolution et l'anticrénelag: Applies the chosen resolution and anti-aliasing to the images the game computes separately, such as Harry's shadow: they stay fine instead of pixelating.
